scope: Offline audit of three complete seven-cell stars in the hash-pinned 5 um local-history fields. Reconstruct local conduction flux at common pre-step physical times and symmetrically split neighbor ever-state from temperature/conductivity feedback; no NIST payload, parameter tuning, or 12.5 ns run.

method.timeAlignment: Pair common pre-step physical times, not step indices; maximum alignment residual 6.595e-17 s. Coarse dt minus the two fine dt sum differs by at most 2.520e-18 s.
method.flux: F(T,E)=sum_faces[(2*k_c*k_j)/(k_c+k_j)]*(T_j-T_c)/h^2; k_i=k_table(T_i)*(0.12 for powder cells above z=0 with everLiquidus=false, otherwise 1).
method.closure: C_E+C_T=F_A-F_B. Accumulated enthalpy contributions additionally include the two-fine-step Euler half-step, source term, and small dt/passive-rate roundoff terms.

interpretation: Neighbor ever-state changes directly contribute to local flux differences. At the cell with the largest temperature difference, the large positive ever term is nearly canceled by negative temperature/conductivity feedback; the terms are not independent global causal percentages. This audit does not show that 25 ns is more accurate and does not establish mesh or time convergence.
nextStep: Offline compare the hash-pinned 20/10/5 um fixed-event fields at one common physical X plane using one contour operator, then vary only section sampling phase on the same fields to isolate measurement-operator sensitivity.
limits: Synthetic local diagnostic only; no experimental validation or NIST raw payload.
Only three local seven-cell stars are analyzed; no global causal inference.
No 12.5 ns solver run and no production solver change.
